notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry describes the tower itself; the NPS page covers the Witch Dance area and trails, not the tower. No build date, builder, staffing, fire history or access rule was found, so the story is short and says so. The bottom-stair removal is undated. No visit or climbable key was set because the source does not say whether the tower is open. Height 100 ft is converted to 30.5 m. The brief's elevation and county are consistent with the NHLR entry.
